name: Connector — HDRRS
description: Cluster of 16 SMD HDRRS connector parts (male and female, single-row 1x2–1x5 and double-row 2x3–2x6 footprints) sourced from chilaboard-altium-library, all tier C and unreviewed.
selection_hints: Match the exact footprint code (e.g. HDRRS_F_1X4 vs HDRRS_M_1X4) to gender and pin count needed.
Distinguish single-row (1xN) footprints from double-row (2xN) footprints before selecting.
All entries are tier C, generated, and not planner-visible — confirm against the source library before committing.
avoid_when: A reviewed or higher-tier (non-C) part is required.
The required pin count or gender is not among the listed HDRRS footprints.
A through-hole mount is needed, since only SMD variants are present.
